title: Noir
shortDescription: The discipline, context, and memory layer for any agentic CLI
description: An 11-package pnpm monorepo that serves as a host-agnostic orchestration layer for AI coding agents. Noir provides three core capabilities: a spec-driven development workflow (idea → spec → plan → implement → verify), a hybrid retrieval engine combining BM25 and vector kNN with Reciprocal Rank Fusion for working context, and cross-session memory with full governance including audit trail and governed deletion. Features an interactive Ink-based terminal dashboard, a persistent MCP server daemon, 27 built-in skills, and adapters for 5 AI coding hosts. Published as @noir-ai/cli on npm with native installers for macOS, Linux, and Windows. Entirely local-first and privacy-by-construction, with no data leaving the machine without explicit opt-in.
